items.title: Targa Resources (TRGP) Stock Looks Fairly Valued Following Its 7x Five Year Run
items.summary: Targa Resources stock has delivered very strong multi year returns, yet at around US$275.79 per share the broader valuation checks suggest it no longer looks like a clear bargain.
